notes: Duelling and martial pageantry for the warriors' island: training dummy, archery butte, halberd and racks of swords, bronze sentinels, a hall of colours and chequered hangings. Core pieces are the practice yard; the rares are the pageantry.

entries.why: Training dummy for the practice yard
Archery butte, a target on straw
Plate armor set laid out in full, 2x2 champion's display
Pair of bronze sentinel maidens, 3x1 pageant statues
Hall of Colours, 9x1 banner row of the duelling houses
Crimson chequered hanging, a duellist's colours
Wall sword rack of duelling blades
